core/conf.Definition.title: Setting definitions
core/conf.Definition.intro: Append project-specific definitions to conf.CoreSchema. Schema.Load validates supplied values before selected resources open; defining an environment variable does not wire its service. Unknown GOGO_ variables are rejected.

fields.Name: Unique environment name beginning GOGO_. Duplicate or nonprefixed names make the schema invalid.
fields.Default: Literal default string used only when the environment key is absent. An explicitly present empty value replaces the default and may fail validation.
fields.Group: Documentation/scaffolding group label; it does not create a resource dependency.
fields.Kind: String (zero value), Boolean, Integer, Duration, List or URL. Durations use Go syntax; lists split commas, trim spaces and discard empty items.
fields.Sensitive: Wraps the raw value in conf.Secret after Choices validation. Typed parsing is bypassed; owning services must validate secret semantics. Reveal only at trusted provider boundaries.
fields.RequiredFor: Resource names for which an empty value is a CONFIG_REQUIRED error. Empty means no resource-scoped requirement; type/choice validation still applies.
fields.Min: Inclusive integer minimum or duration minimum in nanoseconds. Zero therefore rejects negative integer/duration values; does not constrain strings or secret wrappers.
fields.Choices: Exact raw-string allowlist checked before typed parsing. Empty accepts any otherwise valid value. Include all permitted spellings explicitly.

core/models.Schema.title: Schema options
core/models.Schema.intro: Schema defines model identity, storage and metadata. Register complete schemas before freezing the registry. A concrete schema needs a primary key. Schema validation, registry resolution and backend migration capabilities all apply; metadata alone does not implement persistence.

fields.AppLabel: Required valid application identifier; combines with Name as the stable app.Model key.
fields.Name: Required model identifier; relation targets use AppLabel.Name, not the physical table name.
fields.Table: Physical table identifier. Empty derives lower-case AppLabel_Name.
fields.Fields: Ordered field declarations with unique logical names and database columns. Unknown kinds or invalid per-field combinations fail validation.
fields.PrimaryKey: Optional ordered primary-key field list. Empty derives the key from fields marked PrimaryKey. Names must exist; composite support depends on the operation.
fields.Indexes: Explicit index declarations; index names must be valid and unique and field references must exist.
fields.Constraints: Explicit unique/check constraints. Invalid fields and unsupported expression/deferral combinations fail rather than silently changing semantics.
fields.Ordering: Default ordered field paths, with minus prefixes for descending order; apply a stable tie-breaker where needed.
fields.Abstract: Declares reusable schema metadata rather than an ordinary concrete table. Registry inheritance resolves its fields.
fields.Proxy: Declares a proxy over a concrete model. Does not create an independent unrestricted storage identity.
fields.Unmanaged: Marks schema storage as externally managed. The application remains responsible for compatible tables and migrations.
fields.Parent: Parent schema key for declared model inheritance; registry and ORM must resolve the complete inheritance graph.
fields.ParentLink: Field connecting a concrete child to its parent; use the inheritance contract rather than inventing an unrelated foreign key.
fields.Concrete: Resolved underlying concrete schema identity used by proxy/inheritance handling; not a runtime tenant selector.
fields.AutoCreatedBy: Registry provenance for automatically created intermediary schemas; not an application authorization flag.
fields.AutoCreatedField: Source relation field that caused automatic intermediary creation; preserve registry ownership of generated metadata.
fields.Label: Human-facing singular model label; distinct from the stable model key.
fields.LabelPlural: Human-facing plural label, including Admin headings.
fields.Comment: Backend/documentation table comment metadata, subject to migration support.
fields.Tablespace: Backend-specific table placement metadata; requires a supported database and migration path.
fields.RequiredCapabilities: Explicit backend capability requirements. Missing support must fail checks instead of pretending an advanced descriptor works.

core/models.Index.title: Indexes
core/models.Index.intro: Declare indexes in Schema.Indexes, generate a migration and inspect its SQL. Advanced clauses require compatible dialect capabilities; an index is not an object-permission policy.

fields.Name: Required valid unique index identifier within the schema.
fields.Fields: Ordered indexed field names; every field must exist.
fields.Unique: Creates a uniqueness-enforcing index where supported; false creates an ordinary index.
fields.Method: Backend index method such as btree or a supported PostgreSQL-specific method. Validate support before relying on it.
fields.Condition: Trusted partial-index predicate; never interpolate request input.
fields.Include: Covering-index columns; fields must exist and the backend must support inclusion.
fields.Concurrent: Requests concurrent index creation. Requires a compatible nontransactional migration operation and recovery plan.
fields.NullsDistinct: Optional explicit NULL-distinctness policy. Nil leaves the backend default; unsupported combinations fail capability/SQL validation.

core/models.Constraint.title: Constraints
core/models.Constraint.intro: Constraints participate in schema/migration validation and explicit model checks. Database constraints remain the concurrency boundary; an earlier application uniqueness check is insufficient.

fields.Name: Required valid unique constraint identifier within the schema.
fields.Kind: Constraint family, such as unique or check; only implemented kinds/operations are accepted.
fields.Fields: Referenced fields. Unique constraints require at least one known field.
fields.Expression: Trusted check expression. Expression-based unique constraints require an explicitly supported operation, not this generic shortcut.
fields.Condition: Trusted conditional predicate. Cannot be combined with Deferrable; semicolons/NUL are rejected in expressions and conditions.
fields.Deferrable: Requests transaction-deferrable enforcement where supported. False keeps ordinary enforcement.
fields.NullsDistinct: Optional explicit uniqueness treatment of NULL; nil uses backend defaults. Verify selected operation support.

core/api.ModelOptions.title: Model serializers
core/api.ModelOptions.intro: api.FromModel validates the schema and requires a nonempty field allowlist. It copies metadata but does not persist nested models. Nullable nonunique model fields may be omitted; PATCH still skips absent values and defaults.

fields.Fields: Required explicit model field allowlist; undeclared model fields remain private.
fields.Readonly: Allowlisted fields to expose only in output; model noneditability also makes derived fields readonly.
fields.Writeonly: Allowlisted fields accepted only in input; conflicts with readonly directions fail construction.
fields.Overrides: Complete per-field serializer overrides. Every key must be in Fields; the public field name is retained.
fields.Validate: Whole-object validation passed to the resulting serializer.
fields.RepresentRelation: Explicit authorized relation output callback. Stored target identities must not be exposed merely because they exist.

admin.Inline.title: Inline options
admin.Inline.intro: An inline owns child rows through one declared foreign key to the current parent. Composite inline foreign-key mappings require an adapter. The parent link is never an editable submitted field.

fields.Name: Required valid inline identifier; used for formset naming.
fields.Label: Visible heading. Empty uses the child schema's LabelPlural, then its Name.
fields.FKName: Required child ForeignKey field referencing the exact parent schema.
fields.Schema: Validated registered child-model schema; not the parent schema.
fields.Fields: Editable child field selection. Empty derives editable fields except the parent foreign key.
fields.Exclude: Child fields removed from the form selection.
fields.Readonly: Child fields excluded from writable binding while shown where supported.
fields.Extra: Number of extra empty forms; defaults to zero, cannot be negative or exceed Maximum.
fields.Minimum: Minimum retained child forms; defaults to zero and cannot exceed Maximum.
fields.Maximum: Allocation/edit bound; zero becomes 1000 and values above 1000 fail registration.
fields.CanDelete: Allows the deletion UI subject to parent/child policy and current row ownership.
fields.FormOverrides: Explicit child form declarations by model field name; must remain compatible with inline validation.
fields.ConstraintChecker: Child uniqueness/constraint validation provider, used inside the authorized save flow.
fields.ResolveRelation: Scoped resolution of other child relations; cannot let submitted IDs escape the actor's permitted targets.

admin.Action.title: Actions
admin.Action.intro: Actions operate on a freshly authorized selection through ScopedStore. Confirmation does not freeze permission or row state; both must be checked again at execution.

fields.Name: Stable unique action name used by submitted selections; not arbitrary executable code.
fields.Description: Human-facing action label explaining its effect.
fields.Permission: Required action permission checked through the site's policy; choose the permission matching the actual mutation.
fields.Confirm: Whether to require the framework confirmation step before execution.
fields.Run: Execution callback receiving the current context, scoped store and selected objects. Preserve transaction, audit and repeat-delivery safety.

admin.Fieldset.title: Fieldsets
admin.Fieldset.intro: Fieldsets provide ordered form sections. They are mutually exclusive with ModelAdmin.Fields and cannot repeat a field across sections.

fields.Name: Visible section heading.
fields.Description: Escaped section guidance; not executable HTML or validation logic.
fields.Fields: Ordered model field names in this section, subject to readonly/exclude policy.
fields.Classes: Presentation classes for the section; does not change field validation or authorization.

admin.DisplayColumn.title: Display columns
admin.DisplayColumn.intro: Add computed columns to ModelAdmin.Columns and reference their names in ListDisplay. Callbacks must not query or reveal records outside the current actor scope.

fields.Name: Stable display-column identifier referenced by ListDisplay.
fields.Label: Visible table-column label.
fields.Value: Computes the cell value for the authorized object. Return an error for unavailable data rather than leaking provider details.

async.DispatchOptions.title: Dispatch options
async.DispatchOptions.intro: These values apply to one task signature or dispatch, not its registered task definition. Dispatch validates the payload, routing, time bounds and scope before acceptance; accepted does not mean executed.

fields.ID: Optional stable task ID, set with WithID. Empty invokes the client's ID factory; reuse alone does not guarantee exactly-once external effects.
fields.Queue: Per-message queue set with OnQueue; must belong to ClientConfig.Queues. Otherwise routing/task defaults choose it.
fields.Priority: Priority from 0 through 9, set with WithPriority. Does not preempt already running work or guarantee global ordering.
fields.ETA: Absolute execution-admission time, set with WithETA. Cannot be combined with a nonzero Countdown; delayed dispatch must be running.
fields.Countdown: Relative nonnegative delay, set with WithCountdown. Cannot be combined with ETA.
fields.ExpiresAt: Absolute expiry, set with WithExpiry. Retry/dispatch paths must not schedule work beyond expiry.
fields.Scope: Policy scope supplied with WithScope. It is checked by client/worker authorization, not treated as a grant.
fields.Principal: Actor identity metadata supplied with scope; trusted policy must establish authority independently.
fields.IdempotencyKey: Optional application operation identity carried in the envelope. Your external side-effect logic must enforce idempotency.
fields.CorrelationID: Optional trace/correlation identity; do not encode secrets or raw personal data in it.
fields.Headers: Only explicitly allowed metadata headers, set with WithHeaders. Credential-like names are forbidden.
fields.Stamps: Application metadata set with WithStamps for selection/inspection; respect protocol size bounds and privacy.

connectors/postgres.Config.title: PostgreSQL options
connectors/postgres.Config.intro: postgres.Open parses configuration, connects, probes PostgreSQL 16+ and required extensions, then returns a closable backend. These constructor defaults are distinct from environment-schema defaults; explicitly pass the resolved project values.

fields.DSN: Required PostgreSQL connection string, normally GOGO_DATABASE_URL. Never log the revealed credential-bearing value.
fields.Alias: Logical backend/routing name; empty defaults to default.
fields.SearchPath: Optional single valid schema identifier; sets PostgreSQL search_path. Arbitrary SQL/list fragments are rejected.
fields.MaxOpen: Maximum pool connections per process; zero becomes 20. Negative limits are invalid.
fields.MaxIdle: Maximum idle pool connections; zero becomes 5, so zero does not disable idle pooling here. Cannot exceed MaxOpen.
fields.ConnectTimeout: Connection and startup-probe timeout; zero becomes five seconds. Negative values are invalid.
fields.MaxLifetime: Connection lifetime passed to database/sql. Constructor zero means no lifetime limit; GOGO_DB_MAX_LIFETIME defaults to 30m when your project passes it.
fields.Production: Requires verified TLS on the primary connection and every parsed fallback. Does not silently upgrade an insecure DSN.
fields.RequiredExtensions: Installed PostgreSQL extension names required at startup. Missing extensions fail; this does not install extensions.

connectors/redis.Config.title: Redis options
connectors/redis.Config.intro: Use URL for an ordinary single Redis connection. Address/Sentinel/cluster topology is explicit advanced configuration. All applications that must share state use the same URL-selected database; different logical databases isolate keys, not security or server resources. No application namespace is appended.

fields.URL: Redis URL including credentials and database number. Mutually exclusive with Addresses, MasterName and Cluster. URL credentials are used in URL mode.
fields.Addresses: Explicit host:port addresses when URL is empty. Required in address mode; multiple nonsentinel addresses select cluster behavior.
fields.MasterName: Sentinel master name in address mode; empty leaves direct/cluster selection to the declared topology.
fields.Username: Redis ACL username in address mode. In URL mode put the username in URL.
fields.Password: Redis password in address mode. Production requires a password; URL mode uses its URL credential.
fields.SentinelUsername: Optional Sentinel ACL username, separate from the Redis data-node username.
fields.SentinelPassword: Optional Sentinel authentication password, separate from the data-node password.
fields.Role: Required CacheRole, SessionRole, TaskRole, ResultRole or SchedulerRole. Durable roles enforce the connector's persistence/noeviction checks.
fields.TLS: Optional verified TLS configuration, cloned at construction. InsecureSkipVerify is rejected and minimum TLS is raised to 1.2.
fields.PoolSize: Per-connection pool bound; zero becomes 20, negative values fail.
fields.Timeout: Dial/read/write timeout; zero becomes two seconds. Must be positive; caller context also bounds work.
fields.Cluster: Explicit cluster topology in address mode. Cluster connections require database zero; cannot be combined with URL.
fields.Production: Requires TLS and authentication. Cannot be combined with Development; durability checks still depend on Role.

core/security.HeadersConfig.title: HTTP headers
core/security.HeadersConfig.intro: Construct the middleware once and wrap the relevant router. Allowlists are copied at construction. HTTP host/proxy/CORS policy, CSRF and object authorization are separate layers.

fields.AllowedHosts: Required explicit host allowlist. Empty and wildcard-only hosts are rejected; do not trust an arbitrary Host header.
fields.TrustedProxies: CIDR networks allowed to supply forwarded information. Empty trusts no proxy; configure only actual ingress networks.
fields.HTTPSOrigin: Optional canonical HTTPS origin for redirects; must contain no credentials, query, fragment or path.
fields.HSTS: Strict-Transport-Security lifetime for secure requests. Zero does not enable a positive HSTS lifetime.
fields.CSP: Content Security Policy. Empty uses self-only defaults with object-src none, base-uri self and frame-ancestors none. The {nonce} placeholder uses a per-request nonce.
fields.CSPReportOnly: Uses the report-only CSP header instead of enforcement. False enforces the configured policy.
fields.FramePolicy: X-Frame-Options value; empty defaults to DENY.
fields.ReferrerPolicy: Referrer-Policy value; empty defaults to same-origin.
fields.CORSOrigins: Explicit permitted browser origins; malformed origins are rejected. Does not grant application-level access.
fields.CORSMethods: Allowed CORS methods; empty defaults to GET, HEAD and OPTIONS.
fields.CORSHeaders: Allowlisted request headers for CORS preflight handling.
fields.CORSCredentials: Whether allowed CORS responses permit credentials. Keep allowed origins narrow and retain CSRF protection for cookie-authenticated writes.

core/security.CSRFConfig.title: CSRF
core/security.CSRFConfig.intro: CSRF middleware checks unsafe browser requests using a cookie secret, masked token and origin policy. It is not a replacement for authentication or object permissions. Admin refuses exemptions.

fields.CookieName: CSRF secret cookie name; empty defaults to gogo_csrf.
fields.Secure: Marks the cookie Secure; enable for HTTPS deployments. False exists for explicit local HTTP development.
fields.TrustedOrigins: Additional exact origins permitted by origin checks. Does not remove the token requirement; malformed origins fail construction.
fields.MaxBodyBytes: Body parsing limit for CSRF processing; zero defaults to 1 MiB, negative/zero-after-default invalid values fail. Also bound other request parsers.
fields.Exempt: Optional callback bypassing this middleware for a specific request. Avoid cookie-authenticated mutation exemptions; Admin rejects any non-nil callback.

core/sessions.MiddlewareConfig.title: Session middleware
core/sessions.MiddlewareConfig.intro: Middleware requires a session store and purpose-bound signer. Missing/expired sessions start fresh; provider outages fail with 503. Session writes happen before response commitment, so mutate sessions before starting a stream.

fields.Store: Required selected session persistence backend. An environment backend name does not instantiate it.
fields.Signer: Required signer protecting the browser's session identity; configure stable keys and explicit rotation.
fields.CookieName: Browser session cookie name; empty defaults to gogo_session.
fields.TTL: Session lifetime; zero defaults to 14 days and negative values are invalid.
fields.Secure: Whether the session cookie is HTTPS-only. Cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and scoped to /.
fields.Now: Clock for expiry and persistence; nil uses time.Now. Use a deterministic clock in tests.
